summary: All 24 original JPEGs were opened and visually inspected: 18 focused banner captures and 6 full-page layouts, covering 3 routes at mobile and desktop widths. No blocking visual defect observed in the reviewed banner scope.

manualPixelReview.mobileTargetClearance: All 9 focused mobile banners visibly clear of fixed top/bottom controls. The regions consultation image additionally shows footer links above the bottom bar. Still images do not establish interaction or final-scroll behavior on every route.
manualPixelReview.headerReinspection: A grouped tool rendering appeared to truncate a desktop header phone button. Single-original-image reinspection of 1440/home/budget.jpg and 1440/regions--ayang-dong/budget.jpg showed the complete 1844-0644 button; no source-image clipping defect was confirmed.
manualPixelReview.copyComparison: Text read from the rendered banner pixels, not inferred solely from alt text or filenames. Line wrapping is ignored in the comparison.
manualPixelReview.captionDistinction: The removed common decorative-banner caption was not seen. Retained product-photo/ribbon/product-condition notices are distinct and were not treated as a failure.

machineEvidenceSeparatelyReviewed.source: Existing runner-loopback JSON reports; not a new browser run by this reviewer.

limitations: Visual sampling covers only 3 of 47 routes at 2 widths; all-route coverage comes from the separate machine reports.
Full-page files were visually displayed downscaled. Fine print and every small control were not readable or inspected in those 6 views.
Focused captures center the target banner; preceding/following content may legitimately lie outside the viewport.
No new browser interaction, keyboard navigation, zoom, link destination, ordering flow, or telephone call was performed.
Runner loopback screenshots do not establish public-host HTTP status, deployment revision, service approval, or publication authorization.
